types.title: Every celebration gets its own production

items.name: Weddings
items.text: Reception, hall design, entrances and attractions, and the whole evening run for you.

items.name: Bar mitzvah
items.text: The bar mitzvah boy’s entrance, a moving slow dance, a personalised sweet bar and a party until the end.

items.name: Bat mitzvah
items.text: A theme in the colours she chooses, a photo wall, dancers and an elegant dessert table.

items.name: Private events
items.text: Baby welcome, birthday, engagement, henna or company event. Small or large.

services.title: What I do for you
services.text: Take the whole production, or only the part you are missing. Either way, you have one person to call.

items.name: Full production
items.text: From the first meeting to the end of the night: concept, budget, suppliers, timeline and running the event.

items.name: Day-of coordination
items.text: Booked everything yourselves? I arrive before everyone, coordinate the suppliers and keep the evening on time.

items.name: Event design
items.text: Sweet bars, giant letters, photo walls, arches and balloons, in your colours and your style.

items.name: Supplier management
items.text: DJ, photographers, catering, dancers and performers. I connect, coordinate and follow up with all of them.

blocks.title: You tell me, I take care of the rest
blocks.text: We sit down together, I learn what you love and we build a plan: concept, budget, suppliers and timeline. You approve, I coordinate.

blocks.title: The big day, without the stress
blocks.text: I am there from the very start: I welcome the suppliers, check every corner, and time the entrances and the slow dance. You just enjoy it.

blocks.title: Small details that make the “wow”
blocks.text: A sweet bar branded with your child’s name, a sequin wall, mirror spheres, flowers and arches. Every design is built from scratch for each event.

about.title: Nice to meet you, I’m Liraz
about.p1: For years I have been producing bar and bat mitzvahs, weddings and private events, together with Kobi Bar, the DJ of “Zoog Event Productions”. From the décor to the music, everything under one roof.
about.p2: What matters most to me is making your dream come true: listening, getting every detail right, and being there for you until the last dance.
about.caption: Liraz at work, setting up a sweet bar for a bat mitzvah

process.title: Five steps to the big night

steps.title: First call
steps.text: Tell me about the event, the date and what matters to you. I check my availability.

steps.title: Meeting and ideas
steps.text: We meet, talk about style, colours and budget, and I suggest a concept.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: A clear quote, based on what you chose, with no surprises.

steps.title: Preparation and suppliers
steps.text: I book and coordinate the suppliers, build the timeline and keep you updated.

steps.title: The big day
steps.text: I am there from set-up to the very end, and you celebrate.

reviews.title: What families say
reviews.emptyText: Reviews from the families who celebrated with us will appear here soon. Meanwhile, you can see the events themselves, and the comments, on Instagram.

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: For weddings and bar or bat mitzvahs in high season, it’s best to get in touch a few months ahead. A close date is still worth checking: send a message and I’ll get back to you with an answer.
Mainly northern Israel, and events anywhere in the country by arrangement. Tell me where your event is and we’ll check together.

items.q: Can we book day-of coordination only, without full production?
items.a: Absolutely. You can choose full production, day-of coordination only, design only, or the combination that suits you.

items.q: Do you work with regular suppliers?
items.a: I have suppliers I’ve worked with for years, such as DJ Kobi Bar. If you have already booked your own, I coordinate with them too.

items.q: How do we secure a date? Is there a deposit?
items.a: Once you approve the quote, the date is reserved with a deposit. The amount and terms are written in the quote.

items.q: Do we meet before the event?
items.a: Yes. There is a first meeting at the start, and another meeting or a proper call before the event to go over every detail.
